scientific_integrity: An exact finite census through span 24 and a symbolic multivariate endpoint polynomial factorization were checked with a standalone Python program; the finite census is complete only for the stated class and cutoff. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp statement is restricted to exactly three integer-endpoint intervals, with every occupied run and separating gap at least two cells and continuous Fourier magnitudes. It gives no sharp thresholds for other width/gap floors, no uniqueness against out-of-class masks, and no noisy finite-sample guarantee. Earlier equivalent constrained binary autocorrelation censuses remain a bibliographic risk.
title: A sharp two-pixel Fourier ambiguity threshold for three separated intervals
